tldr: Risk-on bounce: silver ripped ~4% to ~$59 and gold rose back above $4,060 as US stocks snapped a three-day losing streak — relief for the book's highest-beta pain (levered silver + miners), but it's risk appetite, not a rates thaw.
Semis reversed hard — Micron +12%, Sandisk +14%, AMD +8% on its Microsoft AI deal — a direct positive read-through for the HK-tech/Tencent book; earnings-contingent on this week's megacap AI results.

Regime unchanged (hawkish hold + oil-shock war), riskOn nudged to 0.45: the 28-29 Jul FOMC is ~85%+ hold, markets price ~zero 2026 cuts with residual September-hike risk — the durable headwind for silver, gold miners and SG REITs.
US-Iran: a 10-day ceasefire proposal is on the table even as strikes continue and Houthis blockade Saudi (Brent ~$89-90); a de-escalation deal is the single biggest positive swing for the whole book.

Positioning is stretched into the bounce — BofA Bull & Bear near ~9.6 (contrarian reduce-risk) while CNN Fear & Greed still reads 41 (Fear); flows lag price, so respect the two-way risk into the FOMC.
Big cash pile still earns ~3.6-3.9% as productive dry powder — the intended use is the metals/rare-earth pullbacks, not chasing the semis/HK bounce at the top.

regime.label: Hawkish hold meets an oil-shock war (risk-on bounce)
regime.oneLiner: A hawkish, higher-for-longer Fed and an active US-Iran oil war still cap the metals thesis, but a Tuesday risk-on rebound (semis, silver, BTC) firmed breadth into next week's FOMC — a relief bounce into stretched positioning, not a regime change.

topNews.headline: Silver rips ~4% to ~$59 as risk-on rebound lifts the complex
topNews.actionable: Relief for the levered silver sleeve — $56 held and silver is back above $58 — but the driver is risk appetite, not a rates thaw; treat it as a spot to de-risk into ahead of the 28-29 Jul FOMC, not confirmation of a new leg.

topNews.headline: Semis-led rally: Micron +12%, Sandisk +14%, AMD +8%; S&P +0.89%, Nasdaq +1.29%
topNews.actionable: Direct positive read-through for HK-tech beta (SMIC 0981, Hua Hong) and the Tencent book; earnings-contingent on this week's megacap AI results before assuming the chip drawdown is over.

topNews.headline: US-Iran: 10-day ceasefire proposal on the table amid strikes + Houthi Saudi blockade
topNews.actionable: A ceasefire would deflate the Fed-hike premium pressuring silver, gold, semis and HK tech; a blockade escalation spikes oil and hardens higher-for-longer — trade the de-escalation risk, not the individual metals.

topNews.actionable: The durable headwind for levered silver, gold miners and SG REITs is higher-for-longer with hike risk, not cuts; the big cash pile earning ~3.6-3.9% is dry powder for pullbacks.
